Send API Request
Staging
Request Sample: Shell / cURL
curl --request POST \
  --url https://sandbox.payme.io/api/payment-contracts/CONT{GUID}/invoices/ \
  --header 'Accept: application/json' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --header 'PayMe-Merchant-Key: ' \
  --data '{
  "invoices": [
    {
      "name": "test2.png",
      "type": "Invoice Receipt",
      "base64": "",
      "mime_type": "image/png"
    }
  ]
}'
